chapter_notes: Chapter is a general pharmacogenetics review, mechanisms are mentioned only in passing. Skipped 4 statements whose target is neither receptor nor enzyme (neurotransmitter transporters as sites of action of cocaine, amphetamine, desipramine, reserpine, benztropine, tiagabine; antidepressants/antiepileptics targeting neurotransmitter transporters; GABAA receptor ion channel mutation and antiepileptic protection, no direction given; omeprazole as 'proton pump inhibitor'). Drug names cetuximab, trastuzumab, maraviroc, dasatinib appear only as needing pharmacogenetic testing, no mechanism stated, not recorded. CYP substrate and metabolism statements are not mechanisms of action and were not recorded.
